scope: Local HTML fixtures; real delivered JS/CSS; simulated Shopify section responses. No store validation or uploads.

tests.name: Debounce, Shopify locale endpoint, real fragment destinations, images and price display
Out-of-order response cannot overwrite the newest results even when fetch ignores abort
Response arriving during debounce is discarded immediately
Network failure announces error and Enter keeps the native GET search working
Empty results and the all-results link preserve the full query
HTTP 417/429/503 and malformed section responses degrade to a usable search
A stalled request times out and its late response cannot reopen results
Keyboard arrows wrap, maintain combobox focus and Enter opens the selected Shopify destination
Escape preserves the query, aborts pending work, and late responses remain closed
Close, clear, Tab, outside pointer and focus use independent, non-trapping controls
Multiple instances isolate requests, active IDs, focus and query state
Reconnect and repeated module tags do not duplicate requests or clear events with monetta-core.js
Reconnect with the same query rejects responses from the previous connection
Inside the current Monetta dialog, first Escape closes suggestions and second closes the dialog
Blocked localStorage (getter) retains recent searches in memory and can clear them
Blocked localStorage (methods) retains recent searches in memory and can clear them
History persists on reload, is scoped by locale, and recent Enter retains the original query
Corrupt storage and untrusted recent strings stay safe and usable
IME composition waits for completion before requesting suggestions
Without JavaScript, the label, submit button and GET destination work
Without fetch support, enhancement leaves the GET form usable
Layout 390px, text 100%, long names and accessible controls
Layout 390px, text 200%, long names and accessible controls
Layout 834px, text 100%, long names and accessible controls
Layout 834px, text 200%, long names and accessible controls
Layout 1440px, text 100%, long names and accessible controls
Layout 1440px, text 200%, long names and accessible controls
Narrow right-edge field clamps the panel, follows resize and closes when its container hides
Short mobile viewport places suggestions above the field without clipping actions
